name: Awakening: tapping a System explains what it trains and its own penalty

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
On the '[ CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM ]' window, click the 'PERSONALITY' tile

The window now explains 'PERSONALITY SYSTEM' with 'TRAINS INT · CHA', a 'RANK E · WHERE YOU START' list including 'Read (pages) · 10', and an 'IF YOU FAIL A DAY' section that mentions '20 pages of reading' and a written reflection, and no push-ups
The explanation switches to 'FOCUS SYSTEM' and its failure section mentions 'a 60-minute phone-free block'
